subject: RE: RE: FW: this evening
body: Your Monthly Status Report is due tonight, and nothing matters more to the people upstairs. Separately, a few of us are going to the Feathers at five. No pressure either way. I will remember which you chose.

result.title: Monthly Status Report filed
result.body: You file it at 23:58. An automatic reply confirms that your report has been received and may be read.

options.label: Go to the pub with Dennis
